info.title: Smart Hotel Management API (POS ERP Architecture)
info.description: Multi-Company SaaS Hotel Management API with Repository Pattern and Multi-Tenancy

get.summary: 1. Get Hotel profile, policies, and contact information for the public website header/footer.
2. Get list of Room Categories (Room Types) with pricing, capacities, and amenities for website showcase.

3. Search Available Rooms by Date Range, Guest Count, and optional Category.
Checks real-time calendar overlaps against active reservations.

post.summary: 4. Create an Online Reservation (Form Input Boxes - User-Friendly with Pre-filled Demo Data for Swagger and Web Forms).

CompanyCode.description: Hotel Company Code (e.g. GPH01 for Grand Palace, SGL02 for Seagull Resort). Optional if passed via header or query.

RoomTypeId.description: Room Category ID: 1 = Executive Suite, 2 = Deluxe Couple, 3 = Standard Twin

RoomId.description: Specific Room ID (optional - leave 0 to auto-assign best room of this type)

SpecialRequests.description: Special Requests or preferences (e.g. High floor, extra pillow)
SpecialRequests.default: High floor, quiet room, extra pillow

AmountPaid.description: Advance Amount Paid in BDT (0 for Pay at Hotel)

TransactionReference.description: Payment Transaction Reference (bKash/Nagad TrxID or Card slip)

Allows hotel guests to view booking status, room, dates, and balance on the website.

get.summary: 1. Get all images for a specific room.

post.summary:
2. Upload and optimize one or more photos for a room.
Automatically converts to WebP, optimizes file size, uploads to remote FTP server, and saves to database.

put.summary: 3. Set a specific image as the Primary (thumbnail) image for a room.

delete.summary: 4. Delete an image from database and remote FTP server.
